_comment: Example of store/fleet-rules-map.json (install-local, FLEETRULESSYNC1015). scripts/fleet-rules-sync.mjs classifies every level-2 heading of the root CLAUDE.md by prefix: fleet = copied verbatim into store/fleet-rules.md; agent_file = the agents carry it in their own CLAUDE.md; main_only = the main agent's own. An unclassified heading stops the sync. {"heading", "stop_at"} copies a section up to a sub-heading; {"h3", "title"} lifts one level-3 section under its own level-2 title. substitutions turn main-agent literals into the placeholders {{AGENT_ID}}, {{PROJECT_ROOT}}, {{DASHBOARD_ORIGIN}}.
